what: Were the counts generated against the right library?
title: Quality control of CRISPR screen counts
text: Every metric assumes counts library refer sgRNAs. qc_check_library_concordance() compares sgRNA IDs counts library, name libraries shipped crisprFlow, file (library_file). example data contain subset CHIP1 library, library sgRNAs missing counts :
code: qc_check_library_concordance(counts, qc_read_library("CHIP1")) #> # A tibble: 1 × 6 #>   n_library_guides n_count_guides n_shared frac_library_in_counts #>              <int>          <int>    <int>                  <dbl> #> 1            11985           1050     1050                 0.0876 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: frac_counts_in_library <dbl>, concordant <lgl>

title: Quality control of CRISPR screen counts
text: fraction reads assigned library sgRNA consistently high; MAGeCK-VISPR uses 65% minimum. Low rates point wrong library, primer stagger trimming problems, contamination. code: qc_plot_read_mapping(summary_df, meta, interactive = FALSE)

what: Is library representation deep and even?
title: Quality control of CRISPR screen counts
text: qc_sample_stats() computes per-sample metrics counts: number targeting sgRNAs zero reads, median count share reads control sgRNAs. per-sample metric can plotted qc_plot_sample_metric().
